parent.why_this_parent: R1 is the only gate-clean parent (min d_cat = 3.1623 px, 100% of dots strictly > 3 px). Every R0-parented non-PRUNE arm is HOLD under the corrected collar gate (IR-88-47).
parent.how_rebuilt: scripts/build_snap_r1_variants.py::reconstruct_r1 asserts both pinned SHA-256 values before any edit.

question: Does the scarp re-centering gain have a dose-response in the field, or is the whole family a displacement artefact that a sign-flipped control would reproduce?

field.name: edge_scarp_pot
field.recipe: percentile ranks inside the footprint of 0.42*b19 det_elev_slope + 0.23*b12 det_elev Hessian ridge + 0.20*b18 iso_grav_anom_hg + 0.15*b3 tmi_hg
field.source: provided competition 19-band stack only; external LiDAR used = false
field.same_field_as: R0 SNAPscarp2px (fae77ff4) and the R1 scarp family (1944aaf5 / c003d7d7 / f4af84a3)

fp2.edit: apply the 1 px spacing-locked scarp snap twice (second pass starts from the first pass output)
fp2.role: dose extension: remove residual drift left by pass 1
fp2.decision_rule: Blind SGMC above scarp1px (0.097567) by >= 0.0005 promotes fp2 over a single pass; SGMC below parent R1 (0.096083) parks it at HOLD.

fp3.edit: apply the same 1 px snap three times
fp3.role: saturation test: does the climb to a local field maximum keep paying
fp3.decision_rule: Compare with fp2. SGMC(fp3) <= SGMC(fp2) means the single-pass dose is saturated; a continued rise means the field maximum, not the 1 px step, is what pays.

anti1.edit: one pass of the SAME allocator on the NEGATED field (each dot moves <= 1 px onto the weakest edge_scarp_pot cell in its window)
anti1.role: sign-flip negative control: separates 'crest position' from 'any displacement'
anti1.decision_rule: If SGMC(anti1) >= SGMC(fp2), the blind SGMC instrument rewards displacement per se and the scarp family's +0.0015 carries no crest information. If SGMC(anti1) < R1 while fp2 > R1, the direction of the move is doing the work.

predictions_are_not_scores: All three predictions are MODEL projections anchored on the R1 scarp family's blind PROXY ordering. No receipt exists for any file in this lineage; |live delta| < 0.01 is no evidence.

report_only_instruments.catalogue_hide_and_recover: PROXY, reported with n withheld positives and 95% CI; never a gate
report_only_instruments.sgmc_control: PROXY off-catalogue control; never a gate
report_only_instruments.block_density_cv: reported for context (10 km / 12 km); not a gate and no threshold applied

stop_rule: Three arms or two hours, whichever comes first. No submission, no leaderboard access, no page fetch.
